title: The Renaissance Edition
promptLanguage: Ease a long chaptered page with Lenis, and let two picture planes move at different rates while a named view transition carries one figure from the opening scene into the next chapter. The feature names stay real text under the pictures.
notes: A painted opening becomes the first product chapter as the visitor scrolls, with Lenis easing the page and a view transition joining later chapters. The updates stay in readable cards, and one scene includes an object that can be bought on the page.
reducedMotion: Reduced motion keeps each chapter as a still picture in order, uses native scroll, and skips the view transition.
